decisions.reason: Memory models sharply outperform the state-only model; memory_slow has the lowest trajectory-level CV error. Alternating has the greatest predicted disagreement among available experiments.
decisions.prediction: Alternating inputs will reveal history-dependent response: output will lag switches and differ from a state-only prediction.

decisions.reason: Saturating memory has the lowest trajectory-level CV error, modestly improving on memory_slow; PRBS offers high disagreement among plausible memory models.
decisions.prediction: Under irregular input switches, history-dependent response will persist, with saturation limiting the effect of accumulated history.

decisions.reason: Memory models strongly outperform state-only models. Memory_multiscale has slightly better trajectory CV error than saturating_memory; a double pulse probes whether responses depend on separated input episodes.
decisions.prediction: The second pulse will produce a history-dependent response that differs from the first pulse, with contributions from both short- and long-timescale memory.
